[SWS_DM_01024] Event Status processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04151
⌈
The DM shall process the existing
Event status
bits ([SWS_DM_00643]) like the
processing of the corresponding
UDS DTC status bits
as specified by the ISO
14229-1 [1] standard.
⌋
ISO 14229-1 Annex D generally defines
UDS DTC status byte
handling and the
corresponding triggerings for them. The three corresponding
Event status
bits are
handled in the same way. The following requirements map interfaces and configuration
parameters of the DM to generic
Event status
bit transition descriptions.
